blocks.text: Anand Sharma is an accomplished professional with 10 years of progressive experience in the cement and construction materials industry. From 2011 to 2021, he has contributed to leading organizations including Jai Prakash Associates Limited (Jaypee Group), JK Lakshmi Cement, and Nuvoco Vistas. Anand brings strong expertise in sales leadership, operations management, market expansion, process optimization, SOP design, client relations, and data-driven strategies across the ready-mix concrete (RMC) and cement sectors. He holds an MBA, strengthening his strategic decision-making, business leadership, and analytical capabilities.
